Mel (People Ops): Hey team — final reminder: SOC2/ISO evidence upload window closes next Friday at 11:59pm PT. Please verify artifacts this week.
Raj (Eng): Thanks Mel. Quick q — are infra runbooks still acceptable as a single PDF or do you want them split by service?
KJ (Compliance): Split by service please, Raj. We need separate ownership fields in each file.
Ezra (Security): Also confirm that logs include the UTC timestamp header. We had one rejected last round for missing the timezone.
Mel (People Ops): Good note. Required naming pattern is below (please use exact format):
```
<control-area>_<owner>-<YYYYMMDD>_evidence.pdf
example: network_ezra-20260212_evidence.pdf
```
Mel (People Ops): Upload link: https://files.redwood.example.com/soc2-evidence (use SSO). If you hit permission errors, ping me or run `aws s3 cp --acl bucket-owner-full-control` as a workaround.
Compliance Bot: Friendly reminder: 3 days left until deadline. You have 2 unsubmitted artifacts assigned.
Raj (Eng): Dropping a note — infra-team will be doing a bulk upload tomorrow morning, ETA ~10am PT. @Mel can you confirm there's capacity to accept a zip containing 40 files?
Mel (People Ops): Yep — bulk uploads are fine, but please include a manifest.csv at the root listing filenames + control mappings. Example columns: filename, control_id, owner, short_desc.
David (Finance): Quick heads-up for teams with contractors: contractor artifacts must include signed NDA snapshot. If the contractor org can't share, mark the artifact as "contractor-exception" and add the point-of-contact in the manifest.
KJ (Compliance): We're running two office hours this week for evidence triage: Wed 2pm PT and Thu 9am PT. Drop in links in #calendar. We're also offering a 20-min "artifact sanity" micro-session — sign up if you want us to glance through before submission.
Raj (Eng): Can you confirm acceptance of screenshots embedded in markdown vs exported PDF? Some docs are screenshots in README.
Ezra (Security): Prefer exported PDF with an index page. Screenshots inside a markdown repo are fine if you export to PDF preserving alt-text.
Mel (People Ops): If you need help mapping controls to artifacts, use this quick checklist in the workspace: https://wiki.redwood.example.com/soc2-mapping. If anything is unclear, mention @KJ so they can assign a reviewer.
Raj (Eng): Upload complete for infra (40 files + manifest). Left a note in the manifest for the one log file missing timezone — will re-export and re-upload in 30 mins.
Compliance Bot: Upload detected from raj. Artifact count: 40. Manifest present.
KJ (Compliance): Received and starting review pass. Expect feedback within 24 hours.
Mel (People Ops): Final note — if you are in APAC and the deadline timezone is problematic, DM me and we'll stagger your window by 48 hours. We don't want anyone blocked by local holidays.
David (Finance): All good from billing side. Reminding teams that reserved capacity invoices may be reconciled after evidence acceptance.
Mel (People Ops): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll post a summary with flagged items after the review completes. :raised_hands:
Raj (Eng): Thanks!
Ezra (Security): Thanks all.
Compliance Bot: Thread archived for reminders.
